author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Why is it SO HARD to finish a piece of work? How does Adam Savage find a balance between responsibilities and fun, and how does he choose which personal projects to prioritize? When does planning a project become avoidance? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members TerryFella_NAFO, ADHDMedia, SpaceMyers and DanielBally, whom we thank for their support! How do you balance between responsibilities and fun?
